headline: Foxpost doubles its pace: new super machine at the Fót logistics center is ready
summary: Following the merger of Foxpost and Packeta, Hungary's largest parcel pickup network, an automated line capable of processing up to 14,000 parcels per hour has started operating in Fót.
why: Packeta is a parcel delivery and logistics operator whose capacity shapes e-commerce delivery costs in Central Europe.
